label: sparse distributed feature, weakly tied to recent p/d inputs (no clean predicate)
explanation: Very sparse (0.065% of steps, about 0.7% of sequences), with low and uniform magnitudes (median 0.118, max 0.248). It fires in all phases: original 31% of mass, delimiter 19%, copy 51%. It is somewhat enriched at the <DEL> step and for L=9. The largest single-value lifts are only about 5-6x: in_tok m/a, prev_tok d/p, prev2_tok p, out_tok n/e/v/x, first_tok n. Activations often fall a few steps after a p (for example in sequences like x 2 p p). But every token-based predicate tried (recent p within 3 steps, in_tok x prev_tok conjunctions, delimiter with p two back, out_tok x next_out pairs) had precision below 1.5% and F1 below 0.03. Most steps matching those patterns stay inactive. It never fires at t=0 or t=1 and rarely at t=2. It looks like a rare conjunction in hidden-state space that the input/output token variables cannot capture.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by phase (copy phase: a, m, e, n; input phase: g, m, t, a; delimiter step: <DEL>) and the token being output, by phase (delimiter step: n, e, v, x; copy phase: n, x, v, j; input phase: ); timing cues that raise it most: L=5 & t=4, L=4 & t=3, L=7 & t=6.
